lines.zh: 横着走才稳，沙滩是我的路。
lines.en: Sideways is the only way I walk.
The sand burns, so I switch legs.
The tide pulled back; I go find shells.
Eight legs moving at once, so step aside.

lines.zh: 沿着浪线走，那里有吃的。
lines.en: I follow the foam line where food is.
My shell scrapes the sand with a dry rasp.

lines.zh: 左边三步，右边三步，前进。
lines.en: Three steps left, three right, and forward.

lines.zh: 退潮的滩涂最适合散步。
lines.en: The exposed flats are the best place to stroll.

lines.zh: 别踩我的影子，我在赶路。
lines.en: Mind my shadow; I am on my way.
I scuttle faster sideways than you think.
Sand works into my joints and it itches.

lines.zh: 我绕着水桶走一圈看看。
lines.en: I circle the bucket once to size it up.

lines.zh: 海风把咸味吹到我脸上。
lines.en: The sea wind blows salt into my face.

lines.zh: 石头底下凉快，我先过去。
lines.en: It is cool under that rock; I am heading there.

lines.zh: 我举着两只钳，横着挪过礁石
lines.en: I cross the reef sideways, claws raised.

lines.zh: 一条死鱼的味道，我赶过去
lines.en: A dead fish smell; I hurry toward it.

lines.zh: 我举着两只螯，谁也不理。
lines.en: I raise both claws and ignore everyone.

lines.zh: 泡泡从嘴里冒出来，一串串。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my mouth in strings.

lines.zh: 我在沙里挖个小坑蹲着。
lines.en: I dig a small pit in the sand and squat.

lines.zh: 旧壳脱下来了，我先吃掉它。
lines.en: My old shell came off; I eat it up.
The waves lull me after a while.

lines.zh: 有只海鸥盯着我，我盯着它。
lines.en: A gull stares at me; I stare back.
Sand clings to my claw, so I rub it off.

lines.zh: 这枚贝壳归我了，先藏好。
lines.en: This shell is mine; I will hide it.
After three waves hit, I head back.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得壳发烫，我挪一挪。
lines.en: The sun heats my shell, so I shift.

lines.zh: 谁把水桶放这儿的？正好。
lines.en: Who left this bucket here? Perfect.
I open and shut my claws, click, click.

lines.zh: 脚边的沙里有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves in the sand by my feet.

lines.zh: 潮水线高了一寸，我该挪窝。
lines.en: The waterline rose an inch; I should move.

lines.zh: 你手里那个桶，看起来很结实。
lines.en: That bucket in your hand looks sturdy.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖快碰到我的螯了。
lines.en: Your boot tip nearly touches my claw.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了我挖的坑。
lines.en: Your boots crushed the pit I dug.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛转个不停。
lines.en: I look up at you, eyes swiveling.

lines.zh: 你伸手是想抓我，还是递吃的？
lines.en: Reaching to catch me, or handing me food?

lines.zh: 你的影子把我的沙滩遮住了。
lines.en: Your shadow has covered my patch of sand.

lines.zh: 我举起螯，只是打个招呼。
lines.en: I raise a claw, only to say hello.
You smell faintly of grilled fish.
Do not reach out; my claw is not soft.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的样子像只大鸟。
lines.en: Bending like that, you look like a big bird.
My shell cracked! Can you pay for that?
That hurts; I flee sideways.

lines.zh: 你踩我的时候没看脚下。
lines.en: You did not look down when you stepped.
My raised claw is only defense.
My claws ache; I give up.
Sand got in the wound; it stings more.
Those boots, I will walk around.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的散步。
lines.en: That interrupted my walk.
All legs intact; I retreat sideways.
The shell regrows, but do not come again.
I smell raw fish; my claws twitch.

lines.zh: 那块鱼肉离我只有两步。
lines.en: That fish is only two steps away.
I will not rush over; let me look first.

lines.zh: 那只水桶里，是不是有鱼？
lines.en: Is there fish in that bucket?
That smell made me forget the tide.
I can come just a little closer.
If your hand shakes, I lunge.
The bait moves; is it alive?

lines.zh: 我闻到蟹黄的味道？不对。
lines.en: I smell crab roe? No, that is wrong.

lines.zh: 为了吃的，横着跑也值得。
lines.en: For a meal, even running sideways is worth it.
You kicked my shell; does your foot hurt?
We collided and neither of us gave way.
Do not push; I cannot dodge sideways quickly.

lines.zh: 我的螯夹住你的裤脚了。
lines.en: My claw has caught your trouser leg.
One bump and the sand flies up.
You stepped on me; I will remember it.
Shall we each step back once?
My shell is hard, so the bump is fine.
You knocked me away from the waterline.
Stand firm; I am not responsible.

lines.zh: 退潮的沙洞最安全，跟我来。
lines.en: The pit at low tide is safest; follow me.
I raise my claws so you can see them.
The burrow you dug is too small.
Let us guard this stretch of beach together.

lines.zh: 壳亮的那只才配得上我。
lines.en: Only a crab with a bright shell is worthy.
Do not pinch me; that is a greeting.
When the tide comes, we move inward.

lines.zh: 我找到一枚完整的贝壳。
lines.en: I found an unbroken shell for you.
Three inches under sand is our home.
Walking sideways, side by side, suits us.
This spiral shell is mine now.
The bucket? I will hold it for you.

lines.zh: 沙里翻出的东西都归我。
lines.en: Whatever I turn up in the sand is mine.
This stone is heavy; I drop it.
My claws carry things quite steadily.
Got it; do not tell the gulls.
This one is too small; I swap it.
I haul the shell to the water to rinse.
I can lift your bucket just fine.
Buried in sand, no one will find it.
The sand stirs over there; I go check.
A small crab has wandered onto my beach.
A gull lands; I lower my body.
Who touched my pile of shells?
That shadow is bigger than my shell.

lines.zh: 我盯住那只蹦跳的东西。
lines.en: I fix on the little thing that hops.

lines.zh: 它退到干沙上，脚步乱了。
lines.en: It backed onto dry sand, steps clumsy.
Target spotted; a good pinch is enough.
I sidle around to get behind it.
Do not block me; I am going in.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，沙沙作响。
lines.en: I lower my body, rustling against the sand.
Claws wide open, I wait for it to come.
It stays still, and so do I.
I am measuring the distance to the water.
The wind comes from the right; I go left.
Its legs are thinner than mine.
One more step and I will snap.

lines.zh: 它喘得急，我知道它怕了。
lines.en: Its breath is fast; it is afraid.
There is no cover on the sand; it is hard.
My shadow pounces before I do.
Pinched, so stop struggling.
My claw snaps shut with a click.
That one you will remember.
I will not let go unless you back off.

lines.zh: 沙里翻起的浪盖过我们。
lines.en: The stirred sand washes over us both.
My claw aches, but it was worth it.
I open my claw; go your way.
I am only guarding my beach.
There is a mark on my shell; I object.
Done fighting; I back away sideways.

lines.zh: 湿沙裂开，我顶开一条缝。
lines.en: The wet sand cracks; I push out.

lines.zh: 浪把我推上滩，又退回去。
lines.en: A wave pushed me ashore and withdrew.

lines.zh: 新壳还没硬，我贴着石头。
lines.en: My new shell is soft; I press to stone.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩有贝壳的味道。
lines.en: This beach smells of shells.
I heard the sea and woke up.
Sand spills out of my joints.
First thing: dig myself a pit.
The sun is fierce; I slip into a crack.
Is there a bucket? I can smell one.
New beach, new rules; I walk the edge.
My shell is scorched red; I must flee.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下，壳先着地。
lines.en: Falling this far, my shell lands first.
The water is too deep; I cannot swim up.
The blast flipped me, claws to the sky.
A hole in my shell lets the wind in.

lines.zh: 这是什么光？我的螯发麻。
lines.en: What light is this? My claws go numb.
Too hungry to lift my claws.

lines.zh: 雷打在滩上，我壳都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the beach; my shell tingles.
No beach below, only emptiness.
